head: 2272f7b520206d8e76d4f86440f92e035e25ce63
decision: May publish otherwise validated draft with explicit candidate nonfatal warning disclosure; no mandatory cleanup/rebuild

policy.quote: Clippy enforces the deny-level lints in [workspace.lints] (root Cargo.toml). cargo clippy exits nonzero only on deny lints, so warn-level output is informational and never blocks a PR.

disclosure: 3 added nonfatal Clippy warnings (2 type_complexity at ClassImageTables byte-key bind length maps,1 unnecessary_cast in static method template),1 prior collapsible_if removed; net+2. Distinct from full-driver32fatal gate failures classified30baseline/2environment.
optional_cleanup_if_root_chooses: Two-file same-type alias for HashMap<(u32,Vec<u8>),u32> and removal of alreadyconst ObjectHeader pointer cast; no lint allows. Not necessary to meet stated warning policy, avoid delaying packet for optional cleanup. Any future source commit still needs exact-head compiler/matchingarchives, source-sensitive checks and targeted acceptance under existing reuse rules.
scope: Publication readiness of own candidate only; no external PR review or merge approval. Required live CI/fragment policy remains applicable.
